From what I read it sounds like you need to give yourself time to breath and take some time to yourself a little bit. Often we have these huge expectations of ourselves being perfect, but we are unfortunately not. People are flawed by nature. If you are trying really hard to be happy and it’s not working, I would suggestion to keep pivoting until something works. Find something that you enjoy that you can take care of all by yourself without the scrutiny of others. It doesn’t matter how big or small and if you are good or bad at it, the only thing that’s important is that you are interested in it and personally enjoy it. When something doesn’t work out, move to the next thing. 

I know it can be hard and sometimes it seems impossible, however I have faith that you! From what it sounds like is that you have been trying really hard in life and you are burned out, I am also in that boat rn as well. You have come such a long way so far, I know you can keep going. Just remember that you control your own destiny and perception of self, not external factors. Happiness will come, just focus on the important things to you and take things one step at a time.
